# glinet_network_interface (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt `network` interface section (including static addresses, VLAN interfaces, and DHCP clients). Destroy forgets ownership by default; set `delete_behavior = "delete"` to remove a named section.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_network_interface" "nas" {
  name         = "vlan11"
  device       = "br-vlan11"
  protocol     = "static"
  address      = "192.168.11.1/24"
  vlan_id      = 11
  display_name = "NAS"
  enabled      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) UCI interface name, such as `lan`, `guest`, or `vlan11`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `address` (String) IPv4 CIDR address, such as `192.168.8.1/24`.
- `delegate` (Boolean) Delegate IPv6 prefix handling.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `device` (String) Underlying device or bridge, such as `br-lan`.
- `display_name` (String) GL.iNet display name.
- `dns` (Set of String) DNS servers for this interface.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled.
- `force_link` (Boolean) Bring up the interface even without a carrier.
- `gateway` (String) Optional IPv4 gateway.
- `protocol` (String) UCI `proto`, normally `static`, `dhcp`, or `none`.
- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN ID for an interface. Zero means unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
